rows.title: The T13 catalogue actions and published toolkits are unbuilt: eleven of the design's twelve catalogue actions and both toolkits are absent
rows.body: The T13 closure review (open items 1-2) records that no toolkit or tool data exists beyond test seeds and that eleven of the twelve catalogue actions are unbuilt; the candidate homes are T14 (import) and T15 (authoring/publication). The capability T13 proves is the governed call path, not the catalogue.
rows.response: Carried by T14's import wave and T15's authoring/publication; the register is read at the tranche-4 review.

rows.title: Job-facing storage is unproven: no action calls JobStorage; the round trip is in-process and the prompt proof is a static compile
rows.body: The closure review's storage clause is partial: adapter-level only, in-memory by default, no job-facing action.
rows.response: A job-facing storage action and an end-to-end proof are the remedy; named at the tranche-4 review.

rows.title: The governed call path's guards stop at the handler boundary: direct external invocation remains possible, and the spend budget and rate limits are unenforced
rows.body: The closure review's open items 3 and 5: the externals guard covers handlers, not callers, and `429 tool_budget_exceeded` and `rate_limit_per_min` are unimplemented.
rows.response: Decide whether the broker is the only job path; the budget is deferred by the owner (2026-11-26, no spend target until the conveyor is whole).

rows.title: The close records the core the gate was written for: one governed call path, a ledger, a data ceiling, a pre-dispatch refusal and a keyless storage adapter
rows.body: The named gaps (catalogue actions, toolkits, credential profiles, spend budget, job-facing storage) are carried by T14/T15 and are not treated as satisfied.

rows.title: T14 carries the import wave and T15 the authoring/publication of the catalogue actions and toolkits that T13 did not land
rows.body: The dependency is directional: T14/T15's design assumes the broker path T13 proves; a divergence reopens this register.
